summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of redesigned LIGHT-theme NivX site + admin CRUD. All requested flows work end-to-end. Landing hero, contact chips, Live Threat Landscape (stats + 24 feed rows), Threat Report featured brief with MITRE kill chain / process tree / IOCs, threat cards + detail dialog, navbar scroll (Support), footer contact info all render correctly on light theme. Admin login (wrong pwd -> login-error 'Invalid email or password'; correct -> admin-dashboard). Create/Edit/Delete threat report via form-title, form-summary, form-submit, edit-N, delete-N all verified (3 -> 4 -> 3 report count).
action_items: Minor: review-request mentioned data-testid 'nav-logo' and 'nav-threat-report' but actual DOM uses 'logo-home' and 'nav-threats' (link id 'threats'). No functional impact — either update spec or rename testids for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Delete uses window.confirm() (native dialog) — acceptable but consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX and easier testability.
Admin token stored in localStorage 'nivx_token' (per spec); consider httpOnly cookie for stronger XSS resilience in production.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_Playwright_Report via admin UI; DB restored to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav testids are nav-about, nav-services, nav-threats, nav-gallery, nav-careers, nav-support (NOT nav-threat-report). Logo testid is 'logo-home'. Admin dashboard testids: threat-form, form-title, form-summary, form-submit, admin-report-N, edit-N, delete-N. Delete triggers native browser confirm — attach page.on('dialog', d.accept()) in playwright.
